scope: Internal functional, responsive, semantic accessibility, focus, state, fallback and console regression testing

evidence_boundary.note: This record documents only checks actually performed in the Codex in-app browser. It must not be used as evidence for UX-03 external usability testing or for the four pending manual accessibility gates.

findings_and_retests.finding: The search input accessible name included the Clear button text because the label wrapped both controls.
findings_and_retests.resolution: Added a direct Lao aria-label to the search input.

findings_and_retests.finding: View switchers and active filters did not expose their selected state.
findings_and_retests.resolution: Added clear Lao aria-label values and aria-pressed to intent, category, view and bottom-navigation controls.

findings_and_retests.finding: Several visible controls were between 32px and 42px and did not meet the 44px touch-target contract.
findings_and_retests.resolution: Raised minimum dimensions for intent chips, view switchers, map markers, section actions, prototype links and QA controls to at least 44px.

findings_and_retests.finding: Closing the QA panel did not have a reliable focus-return contract.
findings_and_retests.resolution: Initial focus now moves to the close button; Close and Escape return focus to the QA trigger with a visible 3px outline.

test_results.coverage: default, loading, empty, error, disabled with reason, sponsored, stale/unknown and Lao long text
search, video/list/map switch, place open/back and query preservation
unavailable video explanation, recovery CTA, Place continuation and missing source disclosure
wrapping and no unintended horizontal overflow
visible button/link/input names, duplicate IDs, image alt text and heading order
initial focus, visible focus, Close/Escape and trigger focus restoration
Discover to Search to Place with announcements
actual browser zoom across Discover, Search, Place and Consent
actual system preference and visual retest
